stays.hotel: Atour Hotel, Liwan (branch to be confirmed)
stays.address: Branch to be confirmed — see the booking confirmation
Chimelong Tourist Resort, Panyu Avenue, Panyu District, Guangzhou
81 Huangpu Avenue West, Tianhe District, Guangzhou

days.pace: Airport pickup; activities from 1 pm, mostly by metro

items.title: Land at the airport, collect luggage
items.tip: After landing, check that mobile data works and open Amap (高德地图) plus WeChat Pay or Alipay. Save the pickup driver's number beforehand.

items.title: Pickup car to Atour Hotel (亚朵)
Leave luggage at the hotel
items.note: Ask whether early check-in is possible, for a shower and change of clothes.

items.title: Lunch
items.note: Near the hotel; keep it quick.

food.name: Baohua Noodle Shop (宝华面店)
food.desc: Long-running shop on Baohua Road. Bamboo-pole wonton noodles (竹升云吞面); served fast.

food.name: Ng Choi Kee Noodles (吴财记面家)
food.desc: Datong Road. Fresh shrimp wonton noodles, fried wontons.

food.name: Ng Zham Kee (伍湛记)
food.desc: Longjin East Road. Jidi congee (及第粥), salty fried dough cakes (咸煎饼).

items.title: Hotel → Animation City (动漫星城)
items.note: Walk to Changshou Lu Station; take Metro Line 1 (towards Guangzhou East Railway Station) to Gongyuanqian Station, 3 stops, ~10 min. Or taxi, ~15 min.
items.tip: Mobile signal may be weak in the underground mall. A meeting point and time should be agreed first.

items.title: Animation City (动漫星城)
items.note: Under Gongyuanqian metro station; Guangzhou's densest anime and manga mall.

items.title: Animation City → Shangxiajiu
items.note: The metro is the easiest option; no transfer needed.

route.title: Gongyuanqian Station (公园前站)
route.desc: Animation City is inside the station. Follow the signs in and take Line 1 (towards Xilang).

route.title: Changshou Lu Station (长寿路站)
route.desc: Before exiting, look for the exit signed “上下九步行街”.

route.title: Shangxiajiu Pedestrian Street (上下九步行街)
route.desc: Enter “上下九步行街” in Amap and start walking navigation. Arrival is obvious from the long row of arcade buildings.

items.title: Shangxiajiu: shopping, dinner, dessert
items.note: One straight street, walked there and back; no turns, no getting lost.

route.title: Heritage shops on Dishifu Road (第十甫路老字号)
route.desc: Photos at the old signboards of Tao Tao Ju (陶陶居) and Lin Heung Lau (莲香楼). Gifts can be bought at Lin Heung Lau.

route.title: Xiajiu Road and Shangjiu Road arcades (下九路、上九路骑楼)
route.walk: Keep walking along the pedestrian street
route.desc: Guangzhou's most complete arcade-building (qilou) street, lined with budget clothing, shoe and small shops. Walk to the end of Shangjiu Road, then turn back.
route.tip: The street is crowded in the evening; backpacks should be worn on the front.

route.title: Hualin Jade Street (华林玉器街)
route.walk: On the way back, turn off Xiajiu Road, ~3 min
route.desc: A cluster of jade and jewellery shops; for browsing only. If the entrance is unclear, ask a shopkeeper or skip it.

route.title: Dinner
route.walk: Back to the west end of Dishifu Road. Chen Tim Kee is in Lane 3, Shiwufu, Baohua Road; Yinji is on Wenchang North Road. Both ~5 min on foot.

food.name: Chen Tim Kee (陈添记)
food.desc: Lane 3, Shiwufu, Baohua Road; a Xiguan snack shop tucked in an alley

food.name: Yinji Rice Rolls (银记肠粉)
food.desc: Original shop on Wenchang North Road

food.name: Crunchy fish skin, sampan congee (爽鱼皮、艇仔粥)
food.desc: Chen Tim Kee signatures

food.name: Shrimp rice rolls, beef rice rolls (鲜虾肠粉、牛肉肠粉)
food.desc: Yinji signatures; add a bowl of congee

food.name: Nanxin Desserts (南信甜品)
food.desc: Dishifu Road. Double-skin milk (双皮奶), ginger milk curd (姜撞奶).

food.name: Shun Kee Ice Bar (顺记冰室)
food.desc: Baohua Road. For ice cream, go here instead; signature coconut ice cream.

route.title: Leave Shangxiajiu
route.desc: Taxi from the roadside on Wenchang South Road back to the hotel, ~10 min.

items.title: Shangxiajiu → Hotel
items.note: Taxi, ~10 min.

days.theme: Shamian, Canton Tower, Beijing Road in the evening
days.pace: Taxi / metro per leg; no full-day car

food.name: Hotel breakfast
food.desc: Saves the most time

food.name: Yinji Rice Rolls (银记肠粉)
food.desc: Original shop on Wenchang North Road. Shrimp rice rolls, beef rice rolls.

food.name: Ng Zham Kee (伍湛记)
food.desc: Jidi congee (及第粥) with fried dough sticks (油条)

items.title: Hotel → Shamian
items.note: Taxi, ~10–15 min. Navigate to “沙面大街”. The morning is spent on foot on the island; no further rides needed.
items.tip: Shamian is quiet in the morning; arriving after 9 is best for photos.

items.title: Shamian Island walking route
items.note: The island is small and the route is a loop; easy to follow.

route.title: Shamian Street (沙面大街)
route.desc: From the drop-off, walk along Shamian Street, the island's central avenue, lined with large banyan trees.

route.title: European-style buildings (欧陆建筑群)
route.desc: Former consulates, trading houses and banks from a century ago, each with a plaque at the door. Best spot for photos.

route.title: Our Lady of Lourdes Chapel (露德天主教圣母堂)
route.desc: Small cream-white church; photos from outside are enough.

route.title: Bronze statues (铜像雕塑)
route.desc: Many life-size bronze figures stand on the streets. Kids can hunt for them and pose with each; whoever finds the most wins.

route.title: Shamian Park (沙面公园)
route.desc: Small park with lawns and benches; kids can rest and run around.

route.title: Pearl River promenade (珠江边步道)
route.walk: Head south to the riverside on Shamian South Street
route.desc: A slow walk along the river, watching the Pearl River and passing boats.

route.title: White Swan Hotel lobby (白天鹅宾馆大堂)
route.walk: At the end of the riverside promenade
route.desc: See the lobby's “故乡水” (Homeland Waters) garden and river views; no purchase required. Lunch is here or nearby.

items.title: Lunch: Shamian
items.note: Eat early; depart for Canton Tower at 12:45.

food.name: Jade River at the White Swan Hotel (白天鹅宾馆 玉堂春暖)
food.desc: Inside the hotel; dim sum with river views. Booking recommended.

food.name: Shamian Island cafés (沙面岛咖啡馆)
food.desc: Several cafés and Western restaurants on the island; light meals.

food.name: Shamian riverside Western restaurants (沙面江边西餐厅)
food.desc: Around Shamian South Street; outdoor seating facing the river.

items.title: Shamian → Canton Tower
items.note: Taxi from the White Swan Hotel entrance, ~25 min. Navigate to “广州塔”. The afternoon is on foot until Huacheng Square, where the next ride is taken.

items.title: Canton Tower, Haixin Bridge, Huacheng Square
items.note: All on foot, from the south bank of the Pearl River to the north bank.

route.title: Canton Tower observation deck (广州塔登塔)
route.desc: Lift to the observation level; all of Guangzhou seen from over 400 m. Tickets should be bought in advance via official channels.
route.tip: Visibility is poor on overcast days; check the weather before leaving. Tickets are best bought in advance via official channels.

route.title: Bubble Tram on the tower top (塔顶摩天轮)
route.walk: Follow the signs on the observation level
route.desc: A Ferris-wheel ride that circles the top of the tower; a kids' favourite. Separate ticket required; queue times vary on the day.

route.title: Haixin Bridge (海心桥)
route.walk: ~5 min walk from the tower to the bridgehead
route.desc: Pedestrian bridge across the Pearl River, ~10 min to cross. The best Canton Tower photo is taken looking back from the bridge.
route.tip: Windy on the bridge and riverbank; bring a jacket.

route.title: Huacheng Square (花城广场)
route.desc: Guangzhou's new central axis, flanked by the Zhujiang New Town towers.

route.title: Dessert
route.walk: Enter Mall of the World (花城汇) via the underground entrance at Huacheng Square
route.desc: Afterwards, a taxi is taken from the mall entrance.

food.name: Crêpe and waffle shops at Mall of the World (花城汇可丽饼、松饼店)
food.desc: Made fresh and hot; right for winter.

food.name: Cha Li Yi Shi, Mall of the World (茶理宜世（花城汇店）)
food.desc: B1, middle zone of the mall; Guangzhou-born Chinese-style milk tea. Signature: Yu Yu You Lan (郁郁幽兰).

items.title: Huacheng Square → Hotel
items.note: Taxi, ~30 min.

items.title: Hotel → Beijing Road
items.note: Taxi, ~20 min. Navigate to “大佛寺”. The rest is on foot around Beijing Road.

items.title: Beijing Road: Dafo Temple, shopping, dinner, dessert
items.note: All stops are within a 5–10 min walk of each other.

route.title: Dafo Temple (大佛寺)
route.desc: May already be closed by early evening. Go in if open; otherwise take photos at the gate.

route.title: Ancient road ruins (千年古道遗址)
route.walk: ~5 min walk to Beijing Road Pedestrian Street
route.desc: Under glass panels in the middle of the street, road surfaces from the Song to the Ming and Qing dynasties can be seen.

route.title: Beijing Road Pedestrian Street (北京路步行街)
route.desc: Arcade buildings, malls and brand stores; lively at night.
route.tip: Crowded at night; belongings should be watched.

food.name: LINLEE (林里（北京路店）)
food.desc: 168 Beijing Road; Guangzhou’s best-known hand-pounded lemon tea, to drink on the walk.

food.name: Taiping Guan (太平馆)
food.desc: Century-old Cantonese-style Western restaurant

food.name: Roast squab, Portuguese chicken (烧乳鸽、葡国鸡)
food.desc: Taiping Guan's signatures

food.name: Wai Yu Lau Teahouse (惠如楼)
food.desc: Old teahouse on Zhongshan 5th Road; go here instead for Chinese food.

route.title: Dessert
route.desc: Afterwards, a taxi is taken from the roadside on Wenming Road.

food.name: Baihua Desserts (百花甜品)
food.desc: Heritage dessert shop on Wenming Road

food.name: Black sesame soup, almond soup (芝麻糊、杏仁糊)

items.title: Beijing Road → Hotel
items.note: Taxi from Wenming Road, ~20 min.

days.intro:
Morning: Shamian Island walk — old European buildings, chapel, riverside
Lunch on Shamian (Jade River dim sum at the White Swan)
Afternoon: Canton Tower, Haixin Bridge, Huacheng Square
Evening: Beijing Road — Dafo Temple, shopping, dinner

Morning walk east: Liwan Lake, Lychee Bay, Xiguan mansions, Bruce Lee's home
Yongqingfang: boutiques and gifts (PICOCICI flagship)
Ice cream at Shun Kee; lunch at Tao Tao Ju
Afternoon: Shangxiajiu arcades to Liwan Plaza
Dinner: Panxi Restaurant

food.name: Hotel breakfast
food.desc: Saves the most time

food.name: Yinji Rice Rolls (银记肠粉)
food.desc: Cloth-steamed rice rolls (布拉肠粉)

food.name: Baohua Noodle Shop (宝华面店)
food.desc: A morning bowl of bamboo-pole wonton noodles

food.name: Ng Zham Kee (伍湛记)
food.desc: Longjin East Road; jidi congee with salted fried cakes. Opens 08:00.

items.title: Morning: on foot east from the hotel
items.note: All on foot, west to east, no backtracking. Nearly two hours are kept for Yongqingfang so the kids can browse boutiques and buy gifts.

route.title: Liwan Lake Park (荔湾湖公园)
route.desc: Lakeside stroll; see the small Qing-style garden Xiaohuafangzhai (小画舫斋). Elderly locals often sing Cantonese opera here.

route.title: Lychee Bay canal and Wenta Pagoda (荔枝湾涌、文塔)
route.desc: Xiguan houses line both banks; walk to Wenta Pagoda for photos. Lychee Bay is the birthplace of sampan congee (艇仔粥).

route.title: Xiguan mansions on Fengyuan Street (逢源大街西关大屋)
route.desc: Sliding-bar gates (趟栊门) and Manchu stained-glass windows (满洲窗) of old Guangzhou's wealthy households.

route.title: Cantonese Opera Art Museum (粤剧艺术博物馆)
route.walk: ~10 min walk south to Enning Road
route.desc: Lingnan garden-style buildings; a quick visit is enough. Closed Mondays, open Wednesdays.

route.title: Bruce Lee's Ancestral Home (李小龙祖居)
route.walk: Cross Enning Road, ~5 min, on Yongqing 1st Lane in Yongqingfang
route.desc: Go in for a look and photos.

route.title: Yongqingfang boutiques and creative shops (永庆坊精品店、文创小店)
route.walk: Browse slowly through the arcade lanes
route.desc: Qilou (arcade buildings) are a Lingnan street form: ground-floor shops are set back, and the upper floors project over the pavement on a row of columns, so the walkway below is shaded from sun and rain. Yongqingfang is a block of restored qilou and old Xiguan houses, mainly Yongqing 1st Lane, Yongqing 2nd Lane and Fushang Lane: narrow lanes, grey-brick walls, sliding-bar gates, packed with creative-design shops, handmade-craft stalls and intangible-heritage gift shops. Fushang Lane has the PICOCICI global flagship store, selling Sanrio, Disney and Chiikawa merchandise, a sure hit with the kids.
route.tip: PICOCICI details are from summer 2026 reports. Other small shops change quickly; buy when something appeals.

route.title: Coffee
route.tip: Yongqingfang shop details are from a 2022 guide; some shops may have changed. Check on site.

food.name: Gonglu Coffee (公路咖啡)
food.desc: Caffeine-free drinks can be ordered for the kids

food.name: Claypot latte (煲仔拿铁)
food.desc: Latte served in a clay pot; very photogenic

route.title: Jiale Egg Tart King (嘉乐蛋挞王)
route.desc: Egg tarts in 8 flavours; buy several and share.

route.title: Yongqing Food Hall (永庆食集)
route.walk: Inside Yongqingfang; heritage snack brands under one roof
route.desc: Grandma's beef offal (阿婆牛杂), Bazhen pan-fried dumplings (八珍煎饺) and Hong Kong Yuanyang King (香港鸳鸯王) are all here. Try only one or two before lunch; one yuanyang milk tea can be shared.

route.title: Enning Ice Cream (恩宁雪糕行)
route.desc: Local-flavour ice cream: chicken biscuit (鸡仔饼), ginger milk curd, Phoenix Dancong tea (凤凰单枞), milk tea. Next door, Enning Gongfei (恩宁公啡) is known for its “檬茶茶”: hand-pulled black tea with dried plum and lemon.

route.title: Enning Road arcade street (恩宁路骑楼街)
route.walk: Walk east along Enning Road, ~10 min
route.desc: Old arcade streetscape all the way; photos on the move. At the east end, Shun Kee is just off Baohua Road; Tao Tao Ju on Dishifu Road is a few minutes further.

route.title: Shun Kee Ice Bar (顺记冰室)
route.walk: At the east end of Enning Road, turn into Baohua Road; ~3 min walk to No. 85.
route.desc: Classic ice bar; coconut and mango ice cream are the signatures. Enning ice cream was just had, so one cup is shared.

items.title: Lunch: Tao Tao Ju (陶陶居), Dishifu Road
items.note: The flagship, open since 1880; Shangxiajiu Pedestrian Street is right outside. ~3 min walk from Shun Kee. After 13:00 on a Wednesday the lunch peak is easing and queues are much shorter. Take a queue number on arrival.

food.name: Shrimp dumplings (鲜虾饺皇)
food.desc: A teahouse essential

food.name: Char siu buns, chicken feet (叉烧包、凤爪)
food.desc: Classic dim sum

food.name: Malay sponge cake, red rice roll (马拉糕、红米肠)
food.desc: One sweet, one savoury

items.tip: Old teahouses usually charge a per-person tea fee; expect it before sitting down.

items.title: Tao Tao Ju → Liwan Plaza
items.note: Walk east along Shangxiajiu Pedestrian Street, arcades the whole way.

route.title: Lingnan Art Studio former residence (岭南艺苑故屋)
route.walk: From Tao Tao Ju, turn into Zhanlu Zhijie; ~3 min on foot.
route.desc: Former home and studio where Lingnan School painting masters ran their academy; a look from the door is enough.

route.title: Xiajiu Road arcades and Wenlan Lane (下九路骑楼、文澜巷)
route.walk: Back on the pedestrian street, heading east
route.desc: Shangxiajiu is Guangzhou's most complete arcade street. Wenlan Lane is where Qing-era Thirteen Hongs merchants founded the Wenlan Academy (文澜书院).

route.title: Hualin Temple and Hualin Jade Street (华林禅寺、华林玉器街)
route.walk: Turn north off Xiajiu Road, ~3 min
route.desc: The old temple and the jade street are side by side; take a look, then return to the pedestrian street.
route.tip: Hualin Temple's opening hours could not be confirmed. Go in if open; otherwise look from the gate.

route.title: Liwan Plaza (荔湾广场)
route.walk: Back on the pedestrian street to the east end of Shangjiu Road

items.title: Liwan Plaza (荔湾广场)
items.note: Long-established mall with many jewellery, watch and small-goods shops; an hour and a half is allowed for browsing.

items.title: Liwan Plaza → Hotel
items.note: Taxi from the entrance, ~10–15 min; slower in evening traffic. Back at the hotel around 16:45.

items.title: Laundry and rest at the hotel
Hotel → Panxi Restaurant (泮溪酒家)
items.note: Panxi Restaurant is at 151 Longjin West Road, beside Liwan Lake Park. ~10 min walk from the hotel towards Liwan Lake; use Amap walking navigation to “泮溪酒家”. Otherwise a minimum-fare taxi, ~5 min.
items.tip: Walking time assumes the Atour is near Lychee Bay; recheck once the hotel address is confirmed.

items.title: Dinner: Panxi Restaurant (泮溪酒家)
items.note: Last night in the old city; a proper meal at the garden restaurant.

food.name: White rabbit dumplings (绿茵白兔饺)
food.desc: Dim sum shaped like little white rabbits; the most photogenic, and a kids' favourite

food.name: Panxi water chestnut cake (泮塘马蹄糕)
food.desc: Made with local Pantang water chestnuts; smooth and lightly sweet

food.name: Honeycomb egg-yolk puffs, quail puff pastry (蜂巢蛋黄角、鹌鹑千层酥)
food.desc: Fried pastries from the restaurant's eight famous dim sum

food.name: Roast suckling pig, eight-treasure winter melon soup (金牌烧乳猪、八宝冬瓜盅)
food.desc: Signatures from the eight famous dishes; for a larger group

items.tip: Booking ahead is recommended; window seats in the garden must be booked early.

items.title: Back to the hotel
items.note: Walk, ~10 min.

food.name: Hotel breakfast
Yinji Rice Rolls (银记肠粉)
food.desc: Last rice-roll breakfast in the old city

food.name: Ng Zham Kee (伍湛记)
food.desc: Longjin East Road; jidi congee with salted fried cakes. Opens 08:00.

items.title: Atour → Chimelong Panda Hotel (长隆熊猫酒店)
items.note: Taxi, ~50 min–1 hr. Navigate to “长隆熊猫酒店”. With many people or bags, book a 6-seater.

items.title: Store luggage; ask at reception
items.note: Four things to confirm: check-in time, shuttle times to each park, how Circus tickets are collected and entry works, and the drone show time and location.

items.title: Lunch: eat early
items.note: Start at 11:45 to beat the 12:00 lunch rush.

food.name: Panda Hotel restaurant (熊猫酒店餐厅)
food.desc: No need to leave the hotel

food.name: White Tiger Buffet (白虎自助餐厅)
food.desc: Inside the Chimelong Hotel; white tigers can be watched while eating

food.name: Wanbo business district (万博商圈)
food.desc: Taxi, ~15 min. Many chain teahouses and Cantonese options

items.title: Get to know the resort
items.note: Routes are learned today so the next two mornings run smoothly.

route.title: Panda Hotel (熊猫酒店)
route.desc: Lobby and corridors are decorated with pandas throughout; a first round of photos is taken here.

route.title: Safari Park entrance (野生动物世界入口)
route.walk: Hotel shuttle, or walk as directed by reception
route.desc: Tomorrow's entry gate and queue position are located.

route.title: Circus theatre and Happy World North Gate (大马戏剧场、欢乐世界北门)
route.desc: The Circus is next to Happy World North Gate. Tonight's entrance is checked, along with the gate for Happy World the day after tomorrow.

route.title: Back to the Panda Hotel (回熊猫酒店)

items.tip: Food delivery cannot enter the parks; it is collected from the delivery lockers next to the hotel.

food.name: Panda Hotel lobby bar (熊猫酒店大堂吧)
food.desc: Western cakes, hot drinks

food.name: Panda-themed desserts (熊猫主题甜点)
food.desc: Panda-shaped cakes from the hotel restaurant; good for photos

items.title: Check in, rest
items.note: Check-in opens at 15:00. A nap is advised; the Circus runs until nearly 21:00.

items.title: Dinner: eat early
items.note: Circus doors open at 17:00; standard seats are first come, first served. Christmas Eve is busy, so go straight after eating.

food.name: Panda Hotel restaurant (熊猫酒店餐厅)
food.desc: Fastest option

food.name: Restaurants around the Circus (马戏场周边餐厅)
food.desc: Fast food near the show area, for when time is short

items.title: Hotel → Circus
items.note: Shuttle, ~10 min. Bring the original ID used for booking; it is checked at entry.

items.title: Enter, claim seats
items.note: In at 17:00 when doors open, for central seats on Christmas Eve. Standard seats are unassigned; earlier is better. The wait is long, so snacks, a tablet or small games should be brought for the kids.
items.tip: Own snacks and drinks are allowed, but strong-smelling food such as durian is not.

items.title: Chimelong International Circus (长隆国际大马戏)
items.note: ~80 min, with animals and aerial acrobatics. Light and sound effects are intense; nervous children can sit near the aisle. Entry is officially not recommended for children under 3 or under 1 m tall.

items.title: Back to hotel
items.note: Exit crowds are heavy. Wait ~10 min for them to thin, then take the shuttle back.

days.intro:
Check out of Atour; taxi to the Chimelong Panda Hotel
Afternoon: get to know the resort
Evening: Chimelong International Circus (19:30)

items.title: Breakfast: eat early
items.note: The buffet is crowded even in low season; go at opening. Take a few pieces of fruit as snacks for the day.

food.name: Panda Hotel breakfast buffet (熊猫酒店自助早餐)

items.title: Pack day bags
items.note: Water, snacks, power bank, jackets (December mornings and evenings are cool). Download the official Chimelong app for queue times and show schedules.
items.tip: Queue times and show schedules are shown in the Chimelong app; check once before entering.

items.title: Shuttle from hotel 2F to North Gate
items.note: Panda Hotel guests may enter 30 min before general visitors, via the North Gate only. Shuttles run ~every 10 min; do not take the one to the South Gate.

items.title: Morning: popular sights first
items.note: The guests-only early half hour is the most valuable; long-queue attractions are done first.

route.title: Safari train (小火车)
route.walk: Straight to the train station after entry
route.desc: General visitors are not in yet, so queues are shortest; later the wait reaches 1 hr. The ~35 min loop passes the big-cat area, giraffes and zebras, all seated.

route.title: Panda Paradise (熊猫乐园)
route.desc: Pandas are most active in the morning, eating bamboo and climbing.

route.title: Koala Park (考拉园)
route.desc: Koalas sleep most of the day; movement is more likely in the morning.

route.title: White Tiger area (白虎区)
route.desc: Lunch follows directly.

items.title: Lunch: Panda Restaurant
items.note: Enter at 11:45 and order before the 12:00 rush.

food.name: Panda Restaurant (熊猫餐厅)
food.desc: In-park themed restaurant with panda-shaped dishes

food.name: Park fast-food outlets (园区快餐店)
food.desc: Nearest one on the route; fastest

items.title: Rest break
items.note: Sit through an indoor show or the 4D cinema to rest for an hour. Schedules per the app.

items.title: Afternoon: animal feeding and cable car

route.title: Asian Elephant Park (亚洲象园)
route.desc: Bananas can be bought to feed the elephants; price as posted on site.

route.title: Giraffe Plaza (长颈鹿广场)
route.desc: Giraffe feeding is the most popular activity and queues are long; one person can queue while the others rest nearby.
route.tip: Feed is sold separately; price as posted on site.

route.title: Dessert stop
route.desc: In-park ice cream or café kiosks: cakes, hot drinks.

route.title: Cable car (空中缆车)
route.walk: Follow the signs to the cable car station
route.desc: The loop takes ~30 min; the whole park is seen from above while seated.

route.title: Flamingo Lake and gift shop (火烈鸟湖、纪念品店)
route.desc: Final flamingo photos, souvenirs, then exit.

items.title: Back to hotel, rest
items.note: Shower; the drone show is tonight.

items.title: Dinner
items.note: The buffet is crowded; go at opening. To skip queues, order à la carte at the Food Town.

food.name: Panda Hotel restaurant (熊猫酒店餐厅)
food.desc: Least effort after a full day

food.name: Food Town (美食小镇)
food.desc: À la carte; shorter queues than the buffet

food.name: White Tiger Buffet (白虎自助餐厅)
food.desc: For a bigger spread

items.title: Drone show (TBC)
items.note: Time and location as announced by reception or the Chimelong app. If the show is on the 26th, move this slot to that evening.

days.intro:
Chimelong Safari Park — early entry for hotel guests
Morning: safari train, pandas, koalas, white tigers
Afternoon: elephant and giraffe feeding, cable car
Evening: drone show (TBC)

items.title: Breakfast: eat early
items.note: Go to the buffet at opening to avoid the crowds.

food.name: Panda Hotel breakfast buffet (熊猫酒店自助早餐)

items.title: Hotel → Happy World North Gate
items.note: Shuttle; queue at the gate before opening. Saturdays are busy, so the earlier the better.

items.title: Thrill rides
items.note: Queues are shortest in the first two hours; the most popular rides are done first. December is cold, so water rides such as the rapids are best skipped.

route.title: Scream Zone: Rocket coaster (尖叫地带：火箭过山车)
route.desc: One of the most popular rides; go straight at opening.

route.title: Rhythm World: Dive coaster (律动天地：垂直过山车)
Super giant pendulum (超级大摆锤)
route.desc: Flips a full 360°; phones and wallets go in a locker first.

items.title: Family rides
items.note: Gentle rides around the Happy Carnival area.

route.title: Star Dream Garden (星梦奇园)
route.walk: Follow the signs from the North Gate
route.desc: Family rides such as the dream carousel and bouncing rides.

route.title: Kids' play area (儿童游乐区)
route.desc: Suited to young children at a slow pace.

route.title: Meet at the restaurant
route.desc: Seats are claimed first.

items.title: Lunch: eat early
items.note: Start at 11:30 to avoid the crowds.

food.name: Coconut Grove Restaurant (椰林餐厅)
food.desc: In-park restaurant, recommended on the official route

food.name: Park fast-food outlets (园区快餐店)
food.desc: Fastest

items.title: Rest break
items.note: Find seating in the park, rest and rehydrate.

items.title: Happy Theatre: magic show (欢乐剧场：魔术表演)
items.note: Seated indoor show with audience interaction. Times per the Chimelong app; official guides mention shows around 14:00 and 16:30. Enter 10 min early.

items.title: Repeat favourite rides
items.note: Crowds thin in the afternoon; the morning's favourites are ridden again.

items.title: Exit via North Gate; shuttle to hotel
Back to hotel: change, rest
items.note: Old town this evening; bring a jacket.

items.title: Panda Hotel → Shawan Ancient Town (沙湾古镇)
items.note: Taxi, ~30–40 min. Navigate to “沙湾古镇”.

items.title: Shawan Ancient Town: dusk to night market
items.note: Lingnan old town founded in the Southern Song, 800+ years old; free entry. Compact; covered entirely on foot.

route.title: Liugeng Hall (留耕堂, He Clan Ancestral Hall)
route.desc: Five-courtyard ancestral hall: the “诗书世泽” plaque, huge timber columns and oyster-shell windows in the rear hall. Visited first while it is still light.

route.title: Wenfeng Pagoda and old streets (文峰塔、古街)
route.desc: Seven-storey pagoda overlooking the wok-ear gabled roofs. Nearby: the old pawnshop, Jinshi Gate and old rice mill. The pagoda's wind chimes are atmospheric at dusk.

route.title: Anning Square light night market (安宁广场光影夜市)
route.desc: Market runs ~17:30–19:00: embroidery, copperware and tea stalls. Saturday the 26th is a weekend, so the adjacent Guangdong Music Hall may have a performance.

route.title: Dinner: old-town snacks
route.walk: Around the night market and old streets; eaten on the go

food.name: Pajinshan fish soup (爬金山鱼羹)
food.desc: Fish soup cooked with dried tangerine peel and lemon leaves

food.name: Puppy congee (狗仔粥)
food.desc: Rice-flour dough shaped like puppies, cooked with shrimp and Chinese sausage

food.name: Shawan Ginger Milk Curd Old House (沙湾姜撞奶老屋甜品店)
food.desc: Set in a converted century-old house with a small courtyard

food.name: Ginger milk curd (姜撞奶)
food.desc: Shawan's signature dessert: ginger juice is poured into hot milk, which sets like tofu

route.title: Liugeng Hall 3D projection (留耕堂3D投影)
route.desc: Projected on the hall's outer wall; tells the town's musical history. Whether it runs is confirmed on site.

items.tip: Streets are flagstone; wear comfortable shoes. It gets cold after dark; bring a jacket.

items.title: Shawan Ancient Town → Panda Hotel
items.note: Taxi, ~30 min; back at the hotel around 20:00.

days.intro:
Chimelong Paradise: Option A family rides / Option B thrill rides
Afternoon: magic show, repeat favourite rides
Evening: Shawan Ancient Town — Liugeng Hall, night market, local snacks

items.title: Breakfast: eat well
items.note: Lunch is not until 13:30, so eat more at breakfast and take some fruit and bread as snacks.

food.name: Panda Hotel breakfast buffet (熊猫酒店自助早餐)

items.title: Last morning at the Panda Hotel
items.note: No rush: panda-themed décor photos, time in the hotel kids' area, or rest in the room.

items.title: Pack, check out
items.note: Panda Hotel checkout is 12:00 at the latest.
items.tip: Check the room before leaving; Chimelong souvenirs are easily left behind.

items.title: Panda Hotel → K Hotel
items.note: Taxi, ~50 min–1 hr. Navigate to “From K Hotel 体育西路”. With many bags, book a 6-seater.

items.title: Check in or store luggage
items.note: If early check-in is not available, luggage is stored.

items.title: Walk to Grandview Mall (正佳广场)
items.note: ~10 min. One of Guangzhou's largest malls, each floor with a different theme. Go straight to 6F for lunch.

food.name: Uncle Qiu Lemon Tea, Tianhe South (丘大叔柠檬茶（天河南店）)
food.desc: 80 Tianhe South Road; signature duck-shit oolong lemon tea (鸭屎香柠檬茶). One can be picked up on the way.

food.name: Cha Li Yi Shi, Tianhe South Road 1 (茶理宜世（天河南一路店）)
food.desc: 92 Tianhe South Road 1; the milk tea option.

items.title: Lunch: Tao Tao Ju (陶陶居), Grandview Mall branch
items.note: Grandview Mall 6F, unit 6C059. Sunday lunch is busy; call before leaving Chimelong to check the queue: 020-38373301.

food.name: Shrimp dumplings (鲜虾饺皇)
food.desc: Essential at any teahouse

food.name: Char siu buns, chicken feet (叉烧包、凤爪)
food.desc: Classic dim sum

food.name: Malay sponge cake, red rice roll (马拉糕、红米肠)
food.desc: One sweet, one savoury

items.tip: Dishes already eaten at the Dishifu Road flagship on the 23rd can be swapped for others this time.

items.title: Grandview 3F: sports brands
items.note: Tennis shoes and sportswear. If time allows, neighbouring Teemall (天河城) and Parc Central (天环广场) are worth a look.

items.title: Fashion Tianhe (时尚天河): anime, collectible toys
items.note: ~10 min walk from Grandview to beneath Tianhe Sports Center. Anime, designer toys and budget shops are concentrated here.
items.tip: Children should be accompanied by an adult or older teen.

items.title: Walk back to hotel
items.note: Either option: walk back to the hotel, ~10 min.

food.name: Grandview 5F–7F restaurants (正佳五至七楼餐厅)
food.desc: Grandview's main dining floors, all cuisines; ~10 min walk

food.name: Chinese restaurant, Grandview Marriott (正佳万豪酒店中餐厅)
food.desc: Right beside Grandview Mall; suited to a proper Cantonese meal

food.name: Tiyu Xilu local eateries (体育西路小馆)
food.desc: Neighbourhood roast meats and claypot congee; nearest and fastest

days.intro:

Afternoon: Option A sports brands / Option B anime and toys

food.name: Hotel breakfast
food.desc: Early departure

food.name: Inside the HSR station
food.desc: Fast-food chains inside the station

items.title: K Hotel → Guangzhou South Station (广州南站)
items.note: Taxi, ~40 min.

items.title: Enter station and wait
items.note: HSR tickets should be bought in advance on 12306. Enter by scanning the ID used for booking.
items.tip: HSR tickets should be bought in advance on 12306. Enter by scanning the ID used for booking.

items.title: HSR: Guangzhou South → Shenzhen North (深圳北)
items.note: ~35 min. Shenzhen North is closest to Bantian, Longgang.

items.title: Shenzhen North → Bantian, Longgang (龙岗坂田)
items.note: Meet the local chartered car at Shenzhen North. Drive ~25 min.
items.tip: Price, hours, and whether tolls and parking are included should be agreed before the charter.

items.title: Robot 6S Store (机器人6S店)
items.note: In the Galaxy WORLD (星河WORLD) campus, Bantian, Longgang. The world's first robot 6S store. Open 10:00–21:00; a ~10-min robot street show starts at 11:00 (moved indoors if it rains).

route.title: Robots cooking on site
route.desc: Jianbing (煎饼果子) and coffee are made by robots on site; they can be bought and eaten.

route.title: Humanoid robot zone
route.desc: Humanoid robots and robot dogs from leading Chinese makers such as Leju (乐聚), Unitree (宇树) and DEEP Robotics (云深处) are demonstrated live.

route.title: Robot parts supermarket
route.desc: Core parts such as servo motors and reducers are shelved like a supermarket. Robots can also be rented, from ~1,000 yuan per day.

items.title: Lunch: Galaxy WORLD COCO Park (星河WORLD COCO Park)
items.note: In the same Galaxy WORLD campus as the Robot 6S Store. Restaurants are concentrated in the mall; no further ride needed.

food.name: Tai Er Sauerkraut Fish (太二酸菜鱼)
food.desc: Popular pickled-cabbage fish chain. Sour, spicy, appetising.

food.name: Chao Xiao Zhan (潮小栈)
food.desc: Chaoshan food: rice noodles, beef balls. ~35 yuan per person.

food.name: Yunhaiyao (云海肴)
food.desc: Yunnan food: steam-pot chicken, wild mushrooms. Milder flavours, suitable for kids.

items.tip: These restaurant names come from older sources; what is in the mall on the day applies.

items.title: AI 6S Store (人工智能6S店)
items.note: In the same Galaxy WORLD robot street, not far from the Robot 6S Store; likely walkable (exact unit unconfirmed). Mostly for makers, developers and brand incubation: of interest to adults for AI hardware; can be skipped by kids.

items.title: Chartered car: Longgang → Shenzhen Bay, Nanshan
items.note: Drive ~40 min.

items.title: INNO100
items.note: Level 1, North Hall, Shenzhen Bay Culture Plaza (northeast entrance, by Talent Park). Open daily 10:00–22:00; free, walk-in. Exoskeletons and smart glasses can be tried. Robot demos and the 3D-printing workshop should be asked about or booked ahead.

items.title: Shenzhen Bay highlights
items.note: Short transfers by chartered car.

route.title: Shenzhen Bay Culture Plaza (深圳湾文化广场)
route.desc: A new cultural landmark of Shenzhen. The architecture itself photographs well.

route.title: Talent Park and Shenzhen Bay Park (人才公园、深圳湾公园)
route.desc: Seafront promenade for sunset; in late December the sun sets around 17:50. After dark, the towers across the water are lit up, best seen from Talent Park.

items.title: Dinner: Shenzhen Bay area

food.name: Runyuan Siji Coconut Chicken (润园四季椰子鸡)
food.desc: Shenzhen's popular coconut chicken hotpot. Light and sweet, not oily; kids usually like the broth.

food.name: Bahe Li Haiji Beef Hotpot (八合里海记牛肉火锅)
food.desc: Chaoshan beef hotpot: hand-beaten beef balls, diaolong (吊龙) cut.

food.name: Restaurants at MixC Shenzhen Bay (深圳湾万象城)
food.desc: Many choices in the mall; easy to get back in the car afterwards.

items.tip: Coconut chicken and beef hotpot are both chains; the driver should be asked to go to the branch nearest Shenzhen Bay.

items.title: Chartered car: Nanshan → Shenzhen North
items.note: Drive ~30 min. When booking, trains from Futian Station (福田站) can also be compared.

items.title: Guangzhou South → K Hotel
items.note: Taxi, ~40 min.

days.theme: Wanguo Outlets, Tianhe Road shopping district
days.intro:
Option A: Wanguo Outlets — sports shoes and clothing
Option B: Tianhe Road mall walk — Teemall, Taikoo Hui, Fashion Tianhe
Back by 14:30; rest for the early start tomorrow

backup.title: Backup: Shahe Clothing Market (only if more clothes are wanted)
backup.note: If energy remains after returning to the hotel in the afternoon, it is ~15 min by taxi from K Hotel. Stalls are fullest in the morning; many close in the afternoon.

items.title: K Hotel → Shahe Clothing Market (沙河服装城)
items.note: Taxi, ~15 min, or metro to Shaheding (沙河顶) station.

items.title: Shahe Clothing Market
items.note: T-shirts, denim, casual wear. Low prices; bargaining is expected. Some stalls are already closed by the afternoon.
items.tip: The wholesale market is crowded. Backpacks should be worn on the front and phones kept away.

items.title: Shahe → Hotel
items.note: Taxi, ~15 min.

food.name: Hotel breakfast
Breakfast shops on Tiyu West Road (体育西路)
food.desc: Rice rolls, congee

items.title: K Hotel → Wanguo Outlets (万国奥特莱斯)
items.note: Taxi, ~20–30 min, on Jiangnan Avenue Middle, Haizhu District. Traffic jams start 700–800 m from the mall; it is easier to get out nearby and walk.

items.title: Wanguo Outlets
items.note: The Nike and Adidas super-flagship discount stores are each larger than six basketball courts. Good for sports shoes, tennis shoes and sportswear.
items.tip: Many sports brands also carry kids' clothing and shoes.

items.title: Lunch: Wanguo Outlets
items.note: Eaten in the mall.

food.name: Restaurants in Wanguo Outlets
food.desc: The mall has a dining area; pick one and sit down.

items.title: More shopping or pick up missed items
Wanguo Outlets → Hotel
items.note: Taxi, ~20–30 min.

items.title: Tianhe Road shopping walk
items.note: The malls are connected or adjacent; the whole route is walked. Lunch at Taikoo Hui or Teemall.

food.name: Restaurants at Taikoo Hui (太古汇)
food.desc: Pleasant setting

food.name: Teemall and Parc Central food (天河城、天环美食)
food.desc: Chain teahouses, fast food

route.title: Teemall (天河城)
route.desc: Long-established mall, with New Year decorations at year end.

route.title: Parc Central (天环广场)
route.walk: Direct via the underground passage from Teemall
route.desc: Underground mall, relatively quiet.

route.title: Taikoo Hui (太古汇)

route.desc: High-end brands and strongly design-led shops.

food.name: French patisserie at Taikoo Hui (太古汇法式甜品店)
food.desc: Macarons, French petits gâteaux

route.desc: Herbal jelly (龟苓膏), 24-herb tea (廿四味). Kids can have the milder Xia Sang Ju (夏桑菊).

route.title: Fashion Tianhe (时尚天河)
route.walk: ~10 min walk to under Tianhe Sports Center
route.desc: Anime, designer toys, budget shops.

items.title: Rest at the hotel
items.note: A proper afternoon rest; an early start is needed tomorrow for Hong Kong.

days.intro:

Star Ferry; lunch in Central; Tai Cheong egg tarts

food.name: Hotel breakfast

items.title: K Hotel → Guangzhou South Station (广州南站)
items.note: Taxi, ~40 min.

items.title: Enter station, security check
items.note: Trains to Hong Kong require earlier arrival; 40 min should be allowed.
items.tip: Documents for entering Hong Kong and returning to the mainland must be carried; check once more before leaving.

items.title: HSR: Guangzhou South → Hong Kong West Kowloon (香港西九龙)
items.note: ~50 min.
items.tip: HSR tickets should be bought as soon as sales open; year-end tickets sell out fast.

items.title: West Kowloon Station border clearance
items.note: Mainland exit and Hong Kong entry are both done inside the station.

route.title: West Kowloon Station → Tsim Sha Tsui
route.desc: Taxi from outside the station, ~15 min.

route.title: Tsim Sha Tsui waterfront and Avenue of Stars (尖沙咀海滨、星光大道)
route.desc: The Central skyline is seen across Victoria Harbour. The Avenue of Stars has a Bruce Lee bronze statue, linking to Bruce Lee's ancestral home visited on the 23rd.

route.title: Star Ferry (天星小轮)
route.walk: Walk to Tsim Sha Tsui pier
route.desc: Century-old ferry; ~10 min across Victoria Harbour.

route.title: Lunch: Central (中环)
route.desc: Eat early to avoid the noon crowds.

food.name: Kau Kee Beef Brisket (九记牛腩)
food.desc: Gough Street; clear-broth beef brisket.

food.name: Tsim Chai Kee Noodle (沾仔记)
food.desc: Wellington Street; fresh shrimp wonton noodles.

food.name: Lan Fong Yuen (兰芳园)
food.desc: Silk-stocking milk tea, pork chop bun.

route.title: Tai Cheong Bakery (泰昌饼家)
route.desc: Flaky-pastry egg tarts, bought and eaten on the go.

food.name: LINLEE Central, Lyndhurst Terrace (LINLEE（中环摆花街店）)
food.desc: Same street; hand-pounded lemon tea goes well with the egg tarts. 4.6 on Google.

route.title: Peak Tram (山顶缆车)
route.walk: ~10 min walk to the Garden Road lower terminus
route.desc: Century-old funicular; the steep tilt of the car on the way up is thrilling and memorable for kids.
route.tip: Queues can be long. A Madame Tussauds + Peak Tram combo ticket gives access to a dedicated lane.

route.title: Madame Tussauds Hong Kong (杜莎夫人蜡像馆)
route.desc: Close-up photos with wax figures of celebrities and athletes; a favourite with kids.

route.title: Victoria Peak (太平山顶)
route.desc: Views over Victoria Harbour and all of Hong Kong Island.

route.title: Peak Tram down
route.walk: Back to the Garden Road terminus

route.title: Ding Ding tram (叮叮车)
route.walk: Walk to Des Voeux Road Central to board
route.desc: Century-old tram. Upper deck front row for street views; ~20 min to Wan Chai.

route.title: Capital Café (華星冰室)
route.walk: Wan Chai MTR Exit A4, walk to 6 Heard Street

food.name: Milk tea, scrambled-egg toast, crispy condensed-milk bun (奶茶、炒蛋多士、脆皮奶油猪仔包)
food.desc: Capital Café signatures

food.name: Pineapple bun with butter, iced lemon tea (菠萝油、冻柠茶)
food.desc: Hong Kong café essentials

route.desc: Well-known Hong Kong ice café: milk tea with scrambled-egg toast or a crispy condensed-milk bun. Shared tables are accepted when queues are long.

items.title: West Kowloon Station border clearance
items.note: 30 min should be allowed.

items.title: Guangzhou South → K Hotel
items.note: Taxi, ~40 min.

days.theme: Dian Dou De, New Year's Eve

items.note: Dian Dou De serves as brunch; no separate breakfast needed.

food.name: Satay beef tripe, steamed chicken feet with lily-bulb sauce (沙爹金钱肚、百合酱蒸凤爪)

food.name: Mango coconut milk layer cake, caramel iced tofu pudding (香芒夹心椰汁糕、焦糖冰豆花)

items.tip: Price, duration, and whether tolls and parking are included should be agreed before the car is booked.

items.title: Foshan Ancestral Temple (佛山祖庙)
items.note: Open 8:30–18:00. The Wong Fei-hung Memorial Hall and Ip Man Hall are inside the grounds; one ticket covers everything.

route.title: Main Hall (祖庙大殿)
route.desc: First built in the Northern Song dynasty, dedicated to the god Beidi. Look up at the coloured ceramic ridge figures, plus the wood and brick carvings — the finest Lingnan architecture on site.

route.title: Lion dance performance area (醒狮表演场地)
route.walk: The venue is shown on the notice at the entrance.
route.desc: Arrive 15 min early to get front-row spots.
route.tip: Lion dance and kung fu shows are suspended in rain; venue and times are per the temple's notice on the day.

route.title: Lion dance and kung fu show (醒狮、武术表演)
route.desc: Daily 10:00–10:40, with afternoon shows at 14:15 and 15:30. Crowded over New Year, so spots should be taken early.

route.title: Wong Fei-hung Memorial Hall (黄飞鸿纪念馆)
route.desc: The life and kung fu of Foshan martial arts master Wong Fei-hung.
route.tip: One listing says the Wong Fei-hung Memorial Hall has been closed since May 2026; this should be checked before the trip. If closed, more time is spent at the Main Hall and Ip Man Hall.

route.title: Ip Man Hall (叶问堂)
route.desc: Memorial hall for Wing Chun master Ip Man; wooden training dummies are available for photos.

items.title: Lingnan Tiandi (岭南天地): stroll and lunch
items.note: ~10 min walk from the temple; no car needed. Foshan's best-preserved old town quarter: stroll, lunch and souvenirs, then back to the temple's Wanfu Stage for opera and the car.

route.title: Clock Tower (钟楼)
route.desc: Lingnan Tiandi's landmark on the central axis; the walls carry ceramic sculptures and “double happiness” tile patterns.

route.title: Jian Family Villas (简氏别墅)
route.desc: Western-style buildings built by the Jian brothers, founders of Double Happiness cigarettes — Foshan's largest surviving early-Republic villa complex. The balconied “Young Ladies' Tower” is where unmarried daughters once watched the street.

route.title: Longtang Poetry Society (龙塘诗社, “Little White House”)
route.desc: Two-storey white building mixing Chinese and Western styles, on the site of a Qing-dynasty literati garden; exhibitions are often held.

route.title: Wedding House (嫁娶屋, 文会里)
route.desc: A house once used for weddings; traditional wedding dress and a bridal sedan chair can be tried for photos.

route.title: Lunch
route.tip: These names come from older guides; check what is open on the day.

food.name: Hang Wan Lau (行运楼)
food.desc: Cantonese, proper sit-down meal

food.name: Taigenbao Rice-free Congee (太艮堡毋米粥)
food.desc: Shunde cuisine; signature is a congee hotpot made with rice broth only

route.desc: Until ~13:15.

route.title: Li Zhongsheng Tang original shop (李众胜堂祖铺)
route.walk: Short walk inside the quarter after lunch.
route.desc: Century-old pharmacy, known for Po Chai pills (保济丸); the loft and chandeliers are worth a look.

route.title: Lei Hei Kee (李禧记) and Foshan Gong (佛山公)
route.desc: Foshan souvenirs: blind man's cakes (盲公饼), maltose candy, and bengsha (崩砂), Lei Hei Kee's classic crisp biscuit.

route.title: China Seasoning Culture Museum (中国调味文化馆)
route.desc: History of Foshan soy sauce and condiments — Haday soy sauce comes from Foshan. A quick loop is enough.

route.title: Shiwan Winery (石湾酒庄, Wine Merchants' Guild Hall 酒行会馆)
route.desc: Former meeting hall of wine merchants; Foshan's Shiwan Yubingshao rice wine is shown. Five minutes is enough.

route.title: Cantonese opera at Wanfu Stage (万福台)
route.walk: ~10 min walk back to the temple.
route.desc: Weekends and holidays 14:00–15:30 on a Qing-dynasty opera stage. About half an hour is enough to get a feel for Lingnan opera.
route.tip: Re-entry to the temple may require a ticket; ask at morning entry whether re-entry is allowed. Show times are per the notice on the day.

route.title: Board the chartered car at the temple

items.title: Chartered car: Foshan → Daliang, Shunde
items.note: ~45 min–1 h drive.

items.title: Daliang: Qinghui Garden and Huagai Road
items.note: All on foot after drop-off.

route.title: Qinghui Garden (清晖园)
route.desc: One of the Four Great Gardens of Lingnan: small bridges, streams, bamboo, carved windows. Over an hour is allowed.
route.tip: The garden closes in the early evening; check the last-entry time at the gate on arrival.

route.title: Huagai Road Pedestrian Street (华盖路步行街)
route.desc: Daliang's oldest arcade street; short, 30–40 min is enough. Lined with old brands, snack shops and souvenir shops; a beef offal stall nearby is good for a skewer on the go.

route.title: Lunjiao cake (伦教糕) and souvenirs
route.desc: Shunde's white sugar cake, lightly sweet and slightly tangy; some can be bought as gifts.

items.title: Walk to dinner
items.note: Both restaurants are a few minutes' walk from Qinghui Garden and Huagai Road.

items.title: Dinner: cooked Shunde dishes
items.note: Both serve cooked food only, so no concern about kids and raw fish.

food.name: Xiangyunsha Garden Hotel (香云纱园林酒店)
food.desc: 25 Qinghui Road, right next to Qinghui Garden; a long-standing Shunde name. Recommended: open-fire roast goose, fried shrimp cake with stir-fried milk

food.name: Daliang Rongbian Spare Rib Rice, Branch 3 (大良容边排骨饭（三店）)
food.desc: 2/F Guangfeng Building, beside Qinghui Garden and Huagai Road. Signatures: steamed spare rib rice, sizzling clay pots, meatball soup, with double-skin milk to finish

items.tip: Rongbian Branch 3 opens for dinner at 17:30, so arriving then means no queue. Tel 13450801998.

items.title: Chartered car: Shunde → Guangzhou
items.note: Leaving at 18:15 avoids the worst of the rush; ~1 h 20 min–1 h 30 min expected on a holiday Saturday, back at the hotel around 19:35–19:45.
items.tip: Traffic into Guangzhou is worst at rush hour; the driver can be asked to pick a less congested route by navigation.

days.theme: Baima & Hongmian, afternoon TBC, Pearl River night cruise

food.name: Hotel breakfast

items.title: K Hotel → Guangzhou Railway Station
items.note: Metro ~25 min to Guangzhou Railway Station (广州火车站), or taxi ~20 min.

items.title: Baima Clothing Market (白马服装市场) and Hongmian International Fashion City (红棉国际时装城)
items.note: Both buildings are next to Guangzhou Railway Station. Baima leans mid-to-upper-range workwear for women; Hongmian leans trendy. Many stalls sell single pieces, and bargaining is accepted.
items.tip: Busy on Sunday mornings; backpacks should be worn on the front. Ask the price before deciding.

food.name: Cha chaan teng (茶餐厅) along Liuhua Road (流花路)
food.desc: A bowl of noodles or roast meat rice, quick

food.name: Fast food inside the malls
food.desc: Eat at the nearest mall around Baima and Hongmian

food.name: Flaky pastries from a bakery
food.desc: For a light bite, egg tarts and flaky buns are enough

food.name: LINLEE, Yuexiu Park (林里（越秀公园店）)
food.desc: B1, Chengyi Hui mall on Liuhua Road, by Yuexiu Park Metro exit C; lemon tea after lunch.

items.title: Dinner: near the hotel or Guangzhou Restaurant

food.name: Near the hotel
food.desc: Grandview Mall / Teemall area; back to the hotel, then a taxi to Tianzi Pier

food.name: Guangzhou Restaurant, Wenchang flagship (广州酒家（文昌总店）)
food.desc: 2 Wenchang South Road; Cantonese institution since 1935

food.name: Wenchang chicken, shrimp dumplings, roast meats (文昌鸡、虾饺、烧味)
food.desc: Guangzhou Restaurant signatures

items.tip: If Guangzhou Restaurant is chosen, the hotel should be left ~16:45 (taxi ~30 min). Afterwards a taxi goes straight to Tianzi Pier (~15 min); no return to the hotel is needed.

items.title: Hotel → Tianzi Pier (天字码头)
items.note: Taxi, ~25 min; at the pier ~18:35, 20+ min before departure.

items.title: Pearl River night cruise (珠江夜游)
items.note: Tickets and pier should be confirmed in advance.
items.tip: Be at the pier 20 min before departure; it is windy on board, so bring a jacket.

days.intro:

Afternoon: TBC

Pearl River night cruise (19:00)

Free day — nothing planned

items.title: Laundry
items.note: Last wash; clothes will be fully dry before tomorrow's departure.

items.title: Pack and sleep early
items.note: Departure for the airport at 05:00 tomorrow. A breakfast box can be requested from reception, and tomorrow's car should be booked in advance.
items.tip: Passports, power banks and daily medicines go in the carry-on; checked bags should be closed up the night before.

items.title: Wake up, check out
items.note: Luggage packed the night before; collect the breakfast box from reception.

items.title: K Hotel → Baiyun Airport (白云机场)
items.note: Taxi, ~45 min; usually no traffic early morning. The car booked the night before is used.
items.tip: The car should be booked in the ride-hailing app the night before, to avoid finding none at dawn.

items.title: Check-in, bag drop, security
items.note: ~2 h 45 min allowed, as for international flights; breakfast at the airport.
